newsItems.title: SIX AND COUNTING FOR HAFIZH
newsItems.description: Malaysia's Hafizh Syahrin Abdullah of JDT RACING TEAM continued his remarkable run of form in the ASB1000 category, producing another dominant performance under pressure.

newsItems.title: HIKARI COMPLETED THE CLEAN SWEEP
newsItems.description: The SS600 action at Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan, saw local favourite Hikari Okubo of SANWA RACING TEAM complete a perfect weekend with a clean sweep.

newsItems.title: HIROKI SEALED DREAM HOME DOUBLE
newsItems.description: The AP250 class at Mobility Resort Motegi saw Japan's Hiroki Ono of HONDA RACING VIETNAM complete a dream weekend with a stunning double victory on home soil.

newsItems.title: SYIRAT'S STUNNING MOTEGI VICTORY
newsItems.description: The UB150 class saw Syirat Sauki of YAMAHA LFN HP969 INDONESIA RACING TEAM emerge victorious in Race 2 at Mobility Resort Motegi.

newsItems.title: PERFECT STRATEGY PUT VICENTE ON TOP
newsItems.description: TVS Racing International Championship at Round 3 of the FIM Asia Road Racing Championship 2026 at Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan, delivered high-octane action.

newsItems.title: FIFTH STRAIGHT FOR HAFIZH
newsItems.description: Hafizh Syahrin Abdullah of JDT RACING TEAM continued his remarkable run in Round 3 of FIM Asia Road Racing with a commanding fifth consecutive victory.

newsItems.title: HIKARI DELIGHTED HOME CROWD IN MOTEGI
newsItems.description: The SS600 category delivered a captivating battle at Mobility Resort Motegi as Japan's wildcard rider Hikari Okubo of SANWA RACING delighted the home crowd.

newsItems.title: HIROKI CLAIMED HOME GLORY
newsItems.description: Home hero Hiroki Ono of HONDA RACING VIETNAM produced a commanding performance under pressure to secure a memorable victory in front of his fans.

newsItems.title: JOHN ENDED 3 YEAR WAIT
newsItems.description: The UB150 class delivered an unforgettable spectacle at Mobility Resort Motegi, Japan as John Emerson Inguito of 4S1M EVO YAMAHA ended his three-year wait for victory.
